note: Validated FED IMPROVE Aerosol, 2003-01-03–2026-02-28; downloaded 2026-10-14. Preliminary data are excluded. Counts describe dated samples with positive, available EC and absorption, rather than the full historical network or the FTIR calibration set. Measurement summaries use each field's available values. Study-site, season, date and exclusion controls do not apply to these summaries. FED's current 2021 absorption records end on 2021-05-31; later samples cannot enter the paired EC/absorption population.
